note: Published fan-engagement promotions for schools that clear the reverse-outlier rule: Group of 5 (and other non-Power 4) schools with a win percentage at or below .500 whose capacity fill is at least 1.25 residual standard deviations above the record-versus-fill line. Record and fill_pct are the season snapshot used when the note was written. fill_pct is the share of listed capacity (1.0 is a full stadium). The page recomputes record and fill for the season on screen and joins these notes by slug. A school with an empty promotions list has no documented promotion in this file. Coastal Carolina's free-concession program is real, but the 2025 crowd is only 0.54 residual standard deviations above the line, so the school is not on this list.

promotions.summary: Every 2026 home date at Kidd Brewer Stadium has a published theme: Gold Out against Maine, Black Saturday Under the Lights against Charlotte, plus Homecoming, Family Weekend, Heroes Day, and Senior Day. Season-ticket holders who renewed by April 15 kept that price for 2026 and 2027 and received early access to discounted single-game tickets.

App State introduced Yosef's Yard Party for Saturday home games in 2026: a free-admission pregame fan zone on the residence-hall lawn, open from three hours before kickoff until 15 minutes before, with yard games, music, and free posters.
For the Sept. 13, 2025 home game against Monmouth, Charlotte Athletics paired Hall of Fame weekend with Family Weekend and asked the crowd to wear green for a Green Out.
UNC Charlotte's student section, the CLT Gold Mine, gets students into games free with a student ID and charges no dues. The group also plans shirt and rally-towel giveaways.

Colorado State's university newsroom said students can claim one free ticket to each home football game, first come, first served, after the school entered the Pac-12. One guest ticket is available for a student at another college or a high school.

For the Sept. 27, 2025 home game against Liberty, Old Dominion entered every fan with a ticket account in a drawing for a seven-day Carnival cruise for two. The athletics release said no extra purchase was required to enter.

Kennesaw State Athletics told students that tickets are complimentary for home regular-season contests when they pay the athletics fee. For 2024, football tickets were claimed online with a student email, opening two weeks before each home game.
